== English errata comparison sources ==
The Players Committee corrects the printed label from HYPERDRIVE to HYPERSPEED. The value 4, game text and other ship attributes are unchanged. Both Wiki articles keep the gameplay hyperspeed value. The earlier E-marked high-resolution picture retains the printed HYPERDRIVE label. It remains a linked File with its provenance.

[[:File:CC-D-slavei-decipher-archive.gif|Original English Dark Side card face]]. Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/ar_version-3-0.pdf#page=110 Advanced Rulebook v3.0], January 2016, Appendix A, PDF page 110. Players Committee, [[Media:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=14|Decipher Errata]], official text as of June 2017, PDF page 14. Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=128|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 128. [[:File:CC-D-slavei.gif|Complete Dark Side replacement face]]. The original Wiki identifier 5_177o is preserved. The pinned Guild source and aliases supply only the bare executable ID.
